rules.title: Notice and opportunity to cure before at-fault just cause termination
rules.requirement: Before terminating a tenancy for an at-fault just cause that is a curable lease violation, the landlord must give written notice describing the violation and an opportunity to cure. If not cured in time, the landlord may serve a three-day notice to quit without another opportunity to cure.

rules.penalty: Failure to strictly comply renders void any required termination notice (§ 98.0706(e), § 98.0710)

rules.title: Notice to Commission of at-fault just cause termination
rules.requirement: The landlord must give the Commission written notice of an at-fault just cause termination within three business days after giving the tenant notice. This requirement applies only 30 days after the Commission establishes a submission portal and gives public notice.

rules.title: Required contents of no-fault just cause termination notice
rules.requirement: For a no-fault just cause termination, the landlord must give at least 30 or 60 days' written notice (per Civil Code 1946.1) in at least 12-point font. The notice must describe the basis for termination, state the right to relocation assistance (direct payment or rent waiver, with amount), and state the tenant's right to an offer to renew if the unit is re-rented within five years.

rules.title: Relocation assistance for no-fault just cause termination
rules.requirement: For a no-fault just cause termination, the landlord must provide relocation assistance, by direct payment or rent waiver, regardless of tenant income or length of tenancy. The amount is two months of actual rent, or three months if the tenant is a senior or disabled. It is credited against other relocation assistance required by other law.

rules.coverage_text: Tenants terminated for no-fault just cause under the Division.
rules.quoted_span: Unless section 98.0706(c)(1)(A)(ii) applies, the direct payment to the tenant shall be in an amount equal to two months of actual rent under the tenant’s lease in effect at the date of the notice.
rules.key_value: 2 months' rent (3 months if senior or disabled)
rules.penalty: Liability for not less than three times the required relocation assistance plus actual economic damages (§ 98.0709(e))

rules.title: Right of first offer to return after no-fault termination
rules.requirement: If the unit is offered for rent within five years after a tenant was evicted for certain no-fault causes, the landlord must first offer in writing to lease it to the displaced tenant who requested the offer in writing within 30 days of the notice and gave contact information. The tenant has 30 days to accept, and the landlord may screen the tenant.

rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted under sections 98.0704(b)(1), (3), or (4) who timely request an offer to renew.
rules.quoted_span: The tenant shall have 30 days from the date of receipt of the offer to accept.

rules.title: Remedies for wrongful eviction and failure to pay relocation assistance
rules.requirement: A landlord who attempts or achieves recovery of possession in violation of the Division is liable for at least three times actual economic damages. A landlord who fails to provide required relocation assistance is liable for at least three times the assistance plus actual economic damages.
